why: This checker exists because a comment claimed it existed. It has to fail in every way a uid pin can stop being checked: the comparison that stops comparing, the missing pin that stops being a problem, a recogniser that finds no agents or every document, an empty run reported as clean, a verdict computed and dropped, and — the one a wrong answer hides behind — the version pin and the image path deciding WHICH image the number is read from.

mutations.name: a uid that differs from the image's is not a problem
mutations.breaks: The whole check. Every manifest reads clean whatever number it pins, which is exactly the state the comment described before this file existed.

mutations.name: an agent with no pinned uid passes
mutations.breaks: The manifest the tree does not yet contain: a new agent that inherits the hardening block without the number, and fails at CreateContainer time on somebody's cluster instead of here.

mutations.name: finding no agent manifests is reported as clean
mutations.breaks: The empty case. A rename, a moved directory, or a recogniser that stopped matching all end here, and the check goes on being counted as protection while examining nothing.
mutations.find:
if not found:
        print("check-agent-uid: no kagent Agent manifests found
mutations.replace:
if not found and False:
        print("check-agent-uid: no kagent Agent manifests found

mutations.name: the recogniser matches no documents
mutations.breaks: The same empty run reached from the other side: every manifest is skipped, so there is nothing to disagree with the image.

mutations.name: the recogniser stops checking the API group
mutations.breaks: Anything called Agent by any project is treated as a kagent agent and required to pin kagent's uid — a check that fails on documents it has no business reading is a check people turn off.

mutations.name: the pin is read only where it is nested today
mutations.breaks: The walk that finds podSecurityContext wherever the CRD nests it, replaced by the fixed path it used to have. Every agent reads as unpinned — but a variant that reported them clean instead is the same edit with the branches swapped.

mutations.name: the findings are collected and the exit code ignores them
mutations.breaks: A checker that does all its work, prints every problem, and exits 0 — the failure mode an exit code alone cannot see.
mutations.find:
if bad:
        print(f"check-agent-uid: {len(bad)} of {len(found)} agent(s) do not run as the image's uid {uid}",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
mutations.replace:
if bad:
        print(f"check-agent-uid: {len(bad)} of {len(found)} agent(s) do not run as the image's uid {uid}",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 0

mutations.name: two disagreeing version pins are no longer refused
mutations.breaks: The Makefile installs one kagent and kmx installs another, and this checks the image of whichever it read first. The uid it proves belongs to a version half the repository does not run.

mutations.name: this repository's values file stops overriding the chart
mutations.breaks: The image is resolved from chart defaults alone, so a values file that pointed agents at a different registry would be invisible and the uid would come from an image the cluster never pulls.

mutations.name: an empty tag stops meaning the chart version
mutations.breaks: The chart leaves agentImage.tag empty and defers to the chart version. Reading the empty string as a tag would test an image reference that does not exist, or — worse — a floating one.
mutations.find: tag = image.get("tag") or values.get("tag") or version
